_comment: Integration tests spin up Testcontainers (Docker) per IClassFixture. Running multiple test classes in parallel creates concurrent Docker container provisioning that overwhelms the daemon and causes intermittent 'Connection refused' on freshly-published broker ports (especially on resource-constrained CI agents and WSL/Docker Desktop hosts). Serialize test collections so containers are spawned/disposed sequentially. Within a single class, tests still run in parallel — that's safe because they share the same fixture-managed container.
